comment: fsd: the six slices cover all 24 user stories: 01 is the plan's harness prefactor; 02 adds the 0.30 baseline refusal (version_missing / version_too_old) for acting commands, status and watch, with release-note criterion; 03 trims upgrade to skills+version+staging+labels, the five-field --json, refusals, removes norn migrate and old-config/needs/.gitattributes rewrites, docs; 04 doctor's version check and init refusal; 05 drops old-layout detection; 06 drops branch/base-tree run state with golden cases limited to the four record-move removals. Dependencies follow the plan (01 before 02, the rest after 02; 06 independent) and every criterion has a test or agent verifier with bun run test and typecheck as checks.
